prompt:
CRITICAL ANTI-TEXT DIRECTIVE: ZERO text of ANY kind. No letters, words, numbers, runes, hieroglyphs, symbols, UI text, watermarks, logos. Use ONLY abstract fracture patterns for decorative markings.

CRITICAL: NO HALO RINGS. No circular discs behind head. No glowing rings.
CRITICAL: NO ANIMALS AT FEET. No companion animals, no creatures. Energy/void patterns only.
CRITICAL: THE HOLLOW IS NOT A PLAYABLE DEITY. This creature must look INCOMPLETE, FRACTURED, CORRUPTED. Where deities radiate divine light, this creature ABSORBS light. Where deities are alive, this creature is ABSENCE. Where deities have faces, this creature has broken or missing masks.
CRITICAL: HOLLOW AESTHETIC — charcoal-black void-stuff body (pure absence given form, NOT metal, NOT stone, NOT flesh). White fracture cracks (cold white lines where light dies, NOT warm energy, NOT fire). Incomplete or broken masks. Broken Gate stone embedded in body (fragments of the original Mythos Gates fused into the form). Negative-space wounds (holes showing ACTIVE NOTHING, the void that consumes). Anti-light seams (absolute black that drinks surrounding light). Ash falling UPWARD (gravity inverts around Hollow creatures).
CRITICAL: NOT EVIL, NOT DEMONIC — the Hollow is EROSION, not malice. It is absence, not corruption with intent. It should feel like looking at a wound in reality, not at a villain. Cold, silent, erasing, not raging or screaming.
CRITICAL: EPIC SCALE — this creature is large but SMALLER than deities. Deities are colossal (hundreds of feet tall). This creature is elite enemy scale (30-50 feet tall). Low camera angle looking up. Show the creature emerging from a Gate fracture or void breach in the ground.
CRITICAL: Readable tactical RPG silhouette — the creature must be readable as a CONTROLLER unit at a glance. Clear weapon or threat indicator. Distinct silhouette from all other Hollow creatures.

Create Hollow Sunless Magistrate, for Mythos Gates: Ascension. The Hollow threat faction.
Faction: The Hollow (non-playable threat faction).
Threat Tier: Elite.
Creature Category: Hollow Creature.
Combat Role: CONTROLLER.
Canon: The Hollow is the anti-civilization that grows in the wound between Realms. It is what the Mythos Gates were built to keep sealed. When the Gates broke, the Hollow came through. This creature carries fragments of broken Gate stone in its body — not as armor, but as the scar of its own creation. Where deities are alive, this creature is absence. Where deities radiate, this creature absorbs.

ART STYLE: Premium dark mythological tactical RPG enemy concept art. Grim dark aesthetic. The Hollow should feel WRONG — like looking at something that should not exist. Not scary in a monster way, but unsettling in an existential way. This is not a demon or a beast — it is a WOUND IN REALITY wearing a shape it stole from something that was real. Painterly textures, deep shadows, void-black depths.

HOLLOW SUNLESS MAGISTRATE — A tall robed absence that judges with broken law.

BODY: Tall, imposing humanoid — 35-40 feet. The body is hidden beneath a flowing robe of charcoal-black void-stuff that moves like fabric but is NOT fabric — it is the absence of everything draping over a form. The robe is covered in ERASING sigils — patterns that were once a civilization's legal text, now being consumed and fading in real-time. The robe drags on the ground, trailing into void-fog.

MASK: A faceless sun disk cracked in half — the mask is a broken sun-disc (taken from a consumed Aten Ra-adjacent culture) that has been CRACKED DOWN THE CENTER. Each half hangs at a slightly different angle on the face, creating a fractured sun-mask. The disc was once gold; now it is charcoal-black with cold white fracture lines. Behind the cracked disc: nothing. No face, no eyes — just the void where a face should be, visible through the crack.

SCALES: Bronze-black scales float around the Magistrate's hands — NOT held, NOT attached, but orbiting slowly in anti-light. The scales are a broken judgment symbol — one side holds a piece of broken Gate stone, the other side holds NOTHING (active void). The scales are always imbalanced, always weighing something against nothing.

JUDGMENT SHARDS: Floating fragments of broken law-stones orbit the Magistrate's body — dark stone tablets covered in erasing runes, orbiting like a halo but NOT a halo (no ring, no disc behind head — the shards float in a scattered cloud). Each shard is a piece of consumed legal text from a different Realm. The shards pulse with cold white anti-light.

GATE STONE: A large keystone fragment embedded in the Magistrate's chest, visible through a tear in the robe. The keystone is cracked, dark grey, with the faint outline of a Gate-arch carved into it. This is the piece of the Mythos Gate that created the Magistrate.

POSE: Standing tall, one hand raised with the scales floating above the palm, the other hand pointing downward at the ground. The pose of a judge passing sentence — but the sentence is ERASURE. The cracked sun-disc mask looks down at the viewer. Not angry — not anything. Absent.

SCALE: 35-40 feet. Low camera angle, looking up at the towering robed judge. The Magistrate should look TALL and IMPOSING, but in a cold, procedural way — like a courthouse that has been emptied of all warmth.

GROUND: The ground around the Magistrate is COVERED in floating judgment shards that have landed — broken law-stones scattered across the ground, each with erasing text. White anti-light fracture lines spread from the Magistrate's feet in geometric patterns — NOT random cracks, but the ghost of a legal grid, the layout of a court that has been erased. Ash falling upward.

BACKGROUND: Dark void environment that looks like a COURTROOM — but wrong. Broken pillars, a cracked judge's bench visible in the distance, all made of void-stuff. The space feels like a courthouse that has been erased from existence. Palette: charcoal-black, bronze-black, cold white, faint sun-disc amber (fading).

VFX: Floating scales always imbalanced. Orbiting judgment shards. Cold white anti-light from the cracked sun-disc. Erasing sigils on the robe visibly fading. Anti-light absorption — light bends toward the Magistrate and dies.

SILHOUETTE: Tall, robed, arm raised with scales. Reads as a controller/commander unit — the scales and judge pose are the primary identifiers. The silhouette should feel like a judge, but WRONG — a courthouse that has been emptied of justice.
